parameters.help_en:
The end time of the IoT card activation time range.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的激活时间区间：结束时间。

格式为：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10, 15, 25, and 40

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card, or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID

The data type.

singlecard: Single-card general data.

directionalcard: Single-card directional data.

sameflowcard: Same-tier pool shared data.

directional_sameflowcard: Same-tier pool shared directional data.

unityPayPool: Unified payment pool general data.

GREcard: Unified payment pool directional data

singlecard：单卡通用流量。

directionalcard：单卡定向流量。

sameflowcard：同档位池共享流量。

unityPayPool：统付池通用流量。

GREcard ：统付池定向流量

parameters.help_en:

micro: Dual-cut plug-in card (consumer-grade).

normal: Standard plug-in card (consumer-grade).

simplus56: Embedded card 5x6 (consumer-grade).

simplus22: Embedded card 2x2 (consumer-grade).

industry-normal: Standard plug-in card (industrial-grade).

industry-micro: Dual-cut plug-in card (industrial-grade).

industry-nano: Triple-cut plug-in card (industrial-grade).

simplus: Embedded card 5x6 (industrial-grade).

simplus22：贴片卡2*2（消费级）。

industry-normal：插拔大卡（工业级）。

parameters.help_en:
The detailed status of the IoT card.

10: Test period.

20: Silent period.

100: In use.

150: Partially in use.

200: Manually deactivated.

300: Deactivated due to data cap.

400: Deactivated by signal control.

500: Deactivated due to rebinding.

600: Deactivated due to real-name verification.

700: Deactivated due to anomaly.

40: Suspended.

50: Canceled
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的具体状态。

10：测试期。

20：静默期。

100：使用中。

150：部分使用中。

200：主动停用。

300：达量停用。

400：信控停用。

500：换绑停用。

600：实名停用。

700：异常停用。

40：已停机。

50：已销户
parameters.name: os_status

parameters.help_en: The data plan tier
parameters.help_zh: 流量包档位
parameters.name: data_level

parameters.help_en:
The status of the IoT card.

35: Deactivated.

50: Canceled
